LESSON: WATER POLLUTION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Matter 2.1 Mixtures (14 Lessons) • Meaning of mixtures • Types of mixtures (hete
Topic 2.2: Water Pollution

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Water Pollution. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Water Pollution
2. Practise Water Pollution at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Water Pollution

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Water Pollution
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Water Pollution. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Water Pollution at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Water Pollution at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Water Pollution
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Water Pollution. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Water Pollution using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Water Pollution in the examples.
2. Explain Water Pollution to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Water Pollution.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Water Pollution using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Water Pollution important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Water Pollution
2. Practise Water Pollution at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Water Pollution

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
